//: Shared compiler options for producing publishable output in packages/*/dist.
The source uses explicit `.ts` extensions in relative imports (`./datom.ts`),
which Bun resolves natively but Node, esbuild and `tsc` in a consumer's
project do not. `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions` (TS 5.7+) rewrites those to
`.js` in both the emitted JS and the emitted `.d.ts`, which is what makes
Emit is unbundled: the module graph and file layout are preserved so the
resolving after the build. Each package extends this and sets rootDir/outDir.
